what: heatr3d COMBINED cross-engine is_sendable gate on the B3 SHIPPABLE ceiling-coupled shaped map. The real Stage A test: does 'shippable on the solve3d dolfinx hold-out' mean 'shippable cross-engine'? Answer for the 0.40x map: NO.
geometry: make_geometry square diam=0.020 zspan=grid.L, n=64, standard 60mm chamber (like-for-like with verify_square_stageA_heatr3d.json)
verdict: NOT cross-engine sendable: heatr3d end-state peak 257.0 C is 7.0 C over the 250 ceiling, though solve3d dolfinx puts it at 249.90 (0.10 under). The ~4.3 C engine offset PLUS the extra shaped-map relocation (~+2.7 C) sum to a 7 C gap on this map.
implication: VALIDATES the cross-engine gate + max-over-engines headroom policy on the first real is_sendable case: single-engine (dolfinx-only) certification would have shipped a map heatr3d says cooks 7 C over. The 0.40x B3 map needs the B4 lower drive carrying the ~15 C Delta_dopant headroom to be sendable by BOTH engines. Neither engine is physical ground truth; heatr3d is the Studio's is_sendable arbiter, and it says NO at 0.40x.
engines: heatr3d_native voxel FDM (n=64) vs solve3d dolfinx FEM tet
